images.prompt: Camera and composition: close-up, eye level, one person's face and shoulders fill most of the frame; the related scene stays softly blurred in the background. Keep the top fifth of the image as softly blurred or plain background (a title band goes there). A Korean son in his 40s in a light gray sweater sits at a family table with his mother in her 70s, both smiling calmly as they talk. Facial expression: explaining with one hand open toward the viewer.  Natural realistic photograph look, soft daylight, shallow depth of field, real Korean people and real Korean places (hospital waiting room, pharmacy counter, community center, home living room), calm and trustworthy mood, muted natural colors, clean composition. Natural colors of the real scene. Korean everyday settings. Show only what is described above as the main subject; do not add other large objects that are not described. Everyone shown looks calm and relaxed; nobody is in pain or scared. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, labels, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No money, banknotes, coins or currency symbols anywhere. Color: cocoa brown and peach tones with a cream accent.
